[{"insert":"Deficit Deadlift Progression

The final deficit deadlift session of the cycle. Standing on a plate increases the range of motion through the bottom of the pull, demanding more from the hamstrings and glutes in the setup position. Reps are at their lowest this week, which means this should be the heaviest pulling work of the six weeks. Aim to beat Week 4 across all working sets.
"}]
